state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `core-http-tlsinfo-expiry-is-a` is closed. `Core\Http\TlsInfo::expiry` throws a `RuntimeError` for a leaf whose `notAfter` is past the last `Core\Time\Instant`, and its reference card names that error. `http.rs` has no gap left.

The perf ledger has current figures for every `Core\Http` feature, and `bun nv proofs --gate` owes nothing across the whole roster. `directive:limits.memory_high_water` now has its about, example, attack and conformance case.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements. Re-measure with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group <class>` after the fix is committed, or the driver's dossier checks go red.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
